title: Polynomial Scaling is Possible For Neural Operator Approximations of Structured Families of BSDEs
abstract: arXiv:2410.14788v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural operator (NO) architectures learn nonlinear maps between infinite-dimensional function spaces and are widely used to accelerate simulation and enable data-driven model discovery. While universality results ensure expressivity, they do not address \emph{complexity}: for broad operator classes described only through regularity (e.g.\ uniform continuity or $C^r$-regularity), information-theoretic lower bounds imply that minimax-optimal NO approximation rates scale \emph{exponentially} in the reciprocal accuracy $1/\varepsilon$. This has shifted the focus of NO theory toward identifying additional problem-specific structure, beyond regularity, under which suitably tailored NO architectures can leverage to unlock polynomial scaling in $1/\varepsilon$.   We exhibit the first polynomial-scaling regime for NO approximations of solution operators in stochastic analysis; by identifying structured families of \emph{non-Markovian} B

translated_title: 结构化倒向随机微分方程族的神经算子逼近可以实现多项式复杂度增长
translated_abstract: 神经算子（NO）架构学习无穷维函数空间之间的非线性映射，被广泛用于加速仿真和实现数据驱动的模型发现。尽管普适性结果保证了其表达能力，但并未解决复杂度问题：对于仅通过正则性（如一致连续性或 C^r 正则性）描述的广泛算子类，信息论下界表明极小极大最优的神经算子逼近速率随精度倒数 1/ε 呈指数级增长。这促使神经算子理论的焦点转向在正则性之外识别额外的问题特定结构，使经过适当定制的神经算子架构能够利用这些结构，从而在 1/ε 上实现多项式复杂度增长。我们展示了随机分析中解算子的神经算子逼近的首个多项式复杂度增长机制；通过识别结构化的非马尔可夫倒向随机微分方程（BSDE）族……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次证明，通过识别结构化的非马尔可夫倒向随机微分方程（BSDE）族，随机分析中解算子的神经算子逼近可以实现随精度倒数 1/ε 的多项式复杂度增长，突破了以往正则性类算子只能达到指数级增长的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first polynomial-scaling regime (in 1/ε) for neural operator approximations of solution operators in stochastic analysis, by identifying structured families of non-Markovian BSDEs, thereby breaking the exponential lower-bound bottleneck for mere regularity-based operator classes.
